findings.title: IP vesting on creation before payment
findings.deviation: Clause 4.1 vests all Intellectual Property Rights in Deliverables in Aldergrove on creation rather than upon receipt of payment.
findings.impact: Aldergrove would acquire ownership of deliverables even if AtliQ is not paid for the services.
findings.quote: All Intellectual Property Rights in the Deliverables vest in Aldergrove on creation.
findings.counterPosition: Intellectual Property Rights in deliverables created specifically for the client shall vest in Aldergrove only upon receipt of full payment.

findings.title: Uncapped liability for IP claims and 150% cap
findings.deviation: Clause 6.1 creates unlimited liability for AtliQ under Clauses 4.3 and 5, and sets the liability cap at 150% of Charges rather than 100%.
findings.impact: AtliQ is exposed to unlimited financial liability for IP warranty and indemnity claims.
findings.quote: Each party's total liability shall not exceed 150% of the Charges, save that the Supplier's liability under Clauses 4.3 and 5 shall be unlimited.
findings.counterPosition: Cap total liability at 100% of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim, with carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct, and confidentiality.

findings.title: One-sided termination for convenience
findings.deviation: Clause 9.1 gives Aldergrove a unilateral right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice without providing a mutual termination right for AtliQ.
findings.impact: AtliQ cannot terminate the agreement for convenience if the project becomes unviable or circumstances change.
findings.quote: Aldergrove may terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice, paying for work done.
findings.counterPosition: Make termination for convenience mutual, allowing either party to terminate on 30 days' written notice with AtliQ paid for work done and work in progress.

fine.note: Delay penalties match AtliQ standard (0.5% per week capped at 5% of milestone for Supplier-caused delay).
IP infringement indemnity is standard and acceptable.
Supplier background materials (IngestIQ) remain owned by AtliQ with a non-exclusive licence granted.
UK GDPR processing role and UK tenant storage requirements are defined.
